set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: F02.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer
Scope: Persist the organizational model and support upgrades from the current schema.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: F02 (bd-01M4W40JE6XGVG1R6TSQQZ6P6S)
Suggested delivery tranche: T2; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Add checksum-checked incremental migrations and required indexes/constraints; migrate existing datasets and curators through explicit governed records.
2. Preserve release IDs, content, historical actor attribution and existing fixed-release access; bootstrap placement remains private and auditable.
3. Prove migration retry, transaction rollback and concurrent record updates; new writes round-trip identically to reference semantics.
4. Use H06.2’s retained legacy corpus where applicable; compare scientific IDs, serialized interpretation/receipt payloads, revoked credentials and exact preexisting grant actions before/after; no curator bypass remains in new-model authorization.

Verification: Disposable-PostgreSQL upgrade fixture from the existing schema plus shared catalog tests and exact historical-export comparison.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/F02.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/Capabilities.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresDatabase.scala
- docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md
- docs/decisions/003-institutional-lifecycle.md
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- F02.1: bd-01M4W5P4YY2S971VAVPV09BJA1
- H06.2: bd-01M4X8MB6FF93SWENVA4256H33

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: F02.2: Migrate PostgreSQL organization records and legacy datasets
